process.h2: How Furniture Movers Work in Boston

steps.title: List the Pieces
steps.text: What's moving, both addresses and any stairs on either end. A photo helps for unusual pieces.

steps.title: Get the Price Explained
steps.text: Furniture moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

steps.title: Wrap and Carry
steps.text: The crew wraps each piece in blankets and shrink wrap and carries it to the truck.

steps.title: Deliver and Place
steps.text: Pieces go into the room you choose, with anything taken apart put back together.

whyChoose.h2: Why Choose Better Life Moving for Furniture Movers in Boston?
whyChoose.intro: Moving one couch shouldn't cost like moving a whole home. Our 2-hour minimum includes travel time, so a small job is billed like a small job. And the crew still wraps every piece and plans the carry the same way it would for a full home.

cards.title: A Minimum Built for Small Jobs
cards.text: Furniture-only moves have a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. One dresser doesn't cost like a house.

cards.title: Wrapping in the Rate
cards.text: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate.

cards.title: Careful on Stairs
cards.text: Customers often mention how our crews handle tough staircases. Boston walk-ups give them plenty of practice.

cards.title: A Real Moving Company
cards.text: Our own crews and trucks, with interstate operating authority under USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489.

faqHeading: Furniture Movers FAQ for Boston Customers

faq.q: Do furniture movers in Boston take single-item jobs?
faq.a: Yes. A single couch, bed or dresser is a normal job for us, billed under the 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

faq.q: Can you pick up furniture I bought online?
faq.a: Yes. Give us the seller's address and yours, and the crew picks it up, wraps it and delivers it.

faq.q: Will a couch fit through my door?
faq.a: Measure the door and the tightest turn on the way in, and send the couch's size when you request a quote. The crew plans the angle and takes legs off where needed.
Yes. Bed frames, tables and other pieces that won't fit whole are taken apart and rebuilt at the other end.

faq.q: Can you move furniture between floors of my house?
faq.a: Yes. Moving heavy pieces between rooms or floors is billed the same way as any local move.

faq.q: How long does a small furniture move usually take?
faq.a: It depends on the distance, the stairs and how many pieces there are. Many single-piece jobs in Boston fit inside the 2-hour minimum, and the manager tells you when yours is likely to run longer.

faqClosing: Still have a question about moving a few pieces? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.

closing.h2: Start Your Furniture Move in Boston
closing.body: Tell us what's moving and both addresses. You'll pay for a small job, not a full house move. Add a photo of anything unusually large and the manager can tell you how long it's likely to take.
